issues.title: Whole-profile replacement can overwrite project configuration
issues.observed: The Rust replacement path can swap the complete project profile directory, including project-owned edits.
issues.desired: Upgrades replace only a versioned managed baseline and preserve project overlays and run state byte-for-byte.
issues.closure_proof: Run KPAR-CFG-0003 against an upgrade fixture and prove the overlay digest and run-state tree are unchanged while the managed baseline advances.

issues.title: Deterministic Lead relay consumes model turns
issues.observed: Rust-era runs used expensive Lead/model turns to relay compiler-derived spawn, wait, and reconciliation decisions.
issues.desired: The TypeScript authority schedules ready work and reconciles terminal attempts deterministically with zero model calls or tokens.
issues.closure_proof: KPAR-SCH-0002 records a complete dispatch/reconcile cycle with both scheduler counters exactly zero.

issues.title: Planning can exceed useful exploration and synthesis budgets
issues.observed: Prompt-only planning spent hundreds of thousands of new tokens, millions cached, or timed out before a structured artifact.
issues.desired: Planning respects the compiled repository-call and token budgets while still producing the complete structured and human-readable plan.
issues.closure_proof: KPAR-PLN-0001 produces an approvable plan below both configured ceilings in repeated isolated fixture runs.

issues.title: Exited worker can remain durably labeled running
issues.observed: A dead identity-bound worker could remain as a stale running warning row even though verified active counts excluded it.
issues.desired: Supervision durably records interrupted/inactive status and resume creates at most one fresh successor attempt.
issues.closure_proof: Extend KPAR-LIF-0001 with a dead-worker restart variant and verify durable terminal status plus one successor; then change state to fixed_in_oracle.

issues.title: Parallel startup and authority contention need composed proof
issues.observed: Earlier smoke work required another three-worker dispatch to prove startup and authority serialization without duplicate active tickets.
issues.desired: Parallel dispatch starts each ready ticket once, stays under max_parallel, and serializes authority effects without contention leaks.
issues.closure_proof: Add a three-worker variant to KPAR-SCH-0001 and capture zero duplicate assignments across repeated authority restarts.

issues.title: Agent setup can show a generic work label
issues.observed: Ticket setup may spend minutes labeled Execute compiled work, which hides what is consuming tokens.
issues.desired: Each row shows a concise phase- and ticket-aware title such as Preparing ticket, running check, or reviewing output.
issues.closure_proof: KPAR-TUI-0001 captures setup, execution, review, and historical rows and finds no forbidden generic title.

issues.title: Blocked stage and retry ownership can be unclear
issues.observed: A supervision/reaping race could leave blocked stage ownership invisible or ambiguous in the control center.
issues.desired: The view model exposes one durable blocked reason, retry owner, and next action on both compact and roomy surfaces.
issues.closure_proof: Add a blocked-run variant to KPAR-TUI-0001 and assert the reason and one retry owner remain visible after restart.

issues.title: Rust transport reconstruction is superseded by native Pi sessions
issues.observed: Rust projected several historical Codex/direct-Pi event envelopes into a custom transcript and needed compatibility readers for each shape.
issues.desired: Native Pi session JSONL is canonical conversation history; Koni stores only workflow bindings, indexes, usage, and terminal results while retaining read-only legacy adapters.
issues.closure_proof: KPAR-SES-0001 proves native Pi fidelity/restore and migration fixtures prove old transcript envelopes remain readable but are never newly produced.
